summary: BioLineRx Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for September 23, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine items: re-election of Class III directors, approval of an increase in authorized share capital, grants of equity-based compensation to the CEO and directors, and reappointment of independent auditors. The filing attaches the notice, proxy statement, and proxy card. This is a routine corporate governance matter with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tenders, or activist campaigns. The record date is August 24, 2026. What to watch: none; this is a standard annual meeting notice with no event-driven implications.
